source_basis.name: Finnish National Agency for Education — Evolving Language Proficiency Scale
source_basis.note: A1.3 is treated as functional elementary proficiency inside CEFR A1: the learner can handle basic familiar social interaction, understand simple familiar text and slow context-supported speech, find simple information, talk about everyday matters with limited language, and write simple messages.

source_basis.name: Council of Europe — CEFR Companion Volume
source_basis.note: The curriculum stays inside CEFR A1 and strengthens predictable everyday interaction, short familiar reading and listening, simple written interaction, and practiced production without claiming the greater independence associated with later CEFR stages.

design_principles: A1.3 remains an implementation subdivision of CEFR A1, not a separate CEFR level.
A1.3 strengthens functional use of familiar language while still assuming predictable situations and a cooperative communication partner.
Every lesson has a concrete communicative outcome and recycles A1.1/A1.2 language before extending it.
High-frequency vocabulary and curated topic vocabulary remain separate curriculum streams.
Items in high_frequency_targets must already exist in the current source-backed common vocabulary dataset; later vocabulary expansion is a separate roadmap item.
Useful expressions, local-case forms, past-tense forms, and sentence frames are stored as explicit reviewed targets and are never generated by suffix concatenation at runtime.
Short reading, listening, messages, and connected three-to-four-sentence output gain more weight than in A1.2 while production remains controlled and familiar.
Grammar is introduced only when it directly supports routine social, home, study/work, planning, or recent-event communication.
Every section ends with a mixed checkpoint and the final checkpoint samples the whole A1.3 path.
stage_outcomes: Handle basic familiar social interactions and keep a short predictable exchange going with simple follow-up language.
Understand simple written text containing familiar vocabulary and expressions and locate individual needed facts.
Understand slow context-supported speech on familiar everyday topics and confirm key details.
Talk about everyday matters and matters personally important to the learner with a limited but usable repertoire.
Write simple messages and a few linked sentences about familiar needs, plans, routines, and recent events.
Use practiced expressions understandably for invitations, changes of plan, home or service problems, study/work needs, opinions, and simple reasons.
Describe a small number of recent events and future plans with explicit reviewed forms rather than generated morphology.

lesson_defaults.lexical_target_count_policy: advisory range; each lesson declares and is validated against lexical_target_count

assessment.criterion_en: Find the key time/detail and write a one- or two-sentence practical reply in 4 of 5 tasks.

lessons.can_do_en: Handle a very short predictable phone exchange with a known person and confirm who should call back.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک گفت‌وگوی تلفنی بسیار کوتاه و قابل‌پیش‌بینی با فرد آشنا را انجام دهد و مشخص کند چه کسی باید دوباره تماس بگیرد.
grammar_focus: telephone identification and callback requests as complete reviewed frames

assessment.criterion_en: Identify the caller and respond appropriately in 4 of 5 predictable phone turns.

lessons.can_do_en: Say a simple preference and ask another person about theirs.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک ترجیح ساده را بیان کند و دربارهٔ ترجیح طرف مقابل بپرسد.

assessment.criterion_en: State and ask about a familiar preference correctly in 4 of 5 prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Give one short reason for a familiar decision or situation.
lessons.can_do_fa: برای یک تصمیم یا موقعیت آشنا یک دلیل کوتاه بیان کند.

assessment.criterion_en: Connect a familiar statement to one appropriate simple reason in 4 of 5 tasks.

lessons.can_do_en: Make a simple suggestion and agree on what to do next.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک پیشنهاد ساده بدهد و دربارهٔ کار بعدی به توافق برسد.
grammar_focus: voidaan and mennään as reviewed suggestion chunks rather than productive passive generation

assessment.criterion_en: Make or respond to a simple suggestion appropriately in 4 of 5 situations.

lessons.can_do_en: Combine greeting, invitation, reason, change of plan, and confirmation in a short familiar exchange.
lessons.can_do_fa: سلام، دعوت، دلیل، تغییر برنامه و تأیید را در یک گفت‌وگوی کوتاه و آشنا ترکیب کند.
